commits: fix: add draft approval gate guidance

requirements.desc: `draft-gate` step guidance must instruct the operator to confirm `draft.json.approval.approved` is true and `approval.confirmedAt` is set before running `sdd-forge flow run gate --phase draft` when no unresolved user decision remains.
requirements.note: R1: draft-gate prompt requires approval setup before running the gate

requirements.desc: The guidance must preserve the existing validation contract: it must not tell users to bypass `DraftApproval.validate()`, loosen draft-gate approval checks, or approve a draft while a `requires_user_decision` item remains unresolved.
requirements.note: R2: draft approval validation remains strict

requirements.desc: The corrected pre-draft-gate approval setup guidance must be verifiable through `src/flow/prompts/plan/draft-gate.md` and the `sdd-forge flow get next-action` instructions for the `draft-gate` step.
requirements.note: R3: draft-gate next-action renders approval setup guidance from prompt source

entries.reason: fix: updated draft-gate prompt wording and refreshed test artifacts after spec-local R1/R3 failures
entries.resolution: test-execute now records current prompt guidance and test-result-review verifies the updated artifact

entries.reason: 要件数が3件を超える範囲一覧があるが、各要件に優先度（must/should/nice-to-have）の割当がありません。; 推奨回答は提示されているが、推奨の根拠が (1) project docs/ (2) guardrail principles/ (3) existing code patterns のいずれかとして明示的に示されていません。
fix: corrected spec-local assertion false positive and refreshed passing R1/R2/R3 artifacts
entries.resolution: test-execute now records all spec-local requirements as pass and test-result-review verdict is pass
